summary: Docs is a collaborative platform designed for note-taking, wikis, and documentation management. It provides a shared space to author and organise structured content at scale.
goodFor: Teams looking for a dedicated self-hosted workspace to maintain internal documentation and collaborative knowledge bases.
watchOut: The software requires significant infrastructure resources to run, and it overlaps with many established proprietary and open-source alternatives.
deployNotes: Because the application runs on Kubernetes, you will typically need to configure persistent volume claims for data storage and set up an ingress controller with TLS termination.
